proposed.text: What should an architect remember about roof drain strainers under the checked RNPC family?

options.text: The strainer net inlet area should be at least equal to the outlet area it serves.
A strainer may reduce inlet area below the outlet area when aesthetics require it.
Strainers are not part of storm drainage coordination.
The strainer rule applies only to sanitary floor drains.

proposed.rationale: The checked RNPC roof-drain provisions require a strainer with adequate net inlet area in relation to the outlet.
